penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Generating a working Transaction Security policy that correctly distinguishes CPQ internal calls from user bulk exports requires deep org-specific analysis of API call patterns, user profiles, and CPQ configuration — per-customer manual work.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise security/compliance buyers at Shield-tier Salesforce accounts will require scoping calls, security review, and stakeholder sign-off before purchasing any policy tooling.

penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: Target segment explicitly includes finance, healthcare, and manufacturing — regulated industries where security policy tooling carries compliance and liability risk.

rationale: While the buyer has demonstrated willingness to pay (Shield + CPQ = significant Salesforce spend), the solution is inherently consulting-shaped: every enterprise org's API call profile, user permission structure, and CPQ configuration is different, making a generic automated tool unreliable or even dangerous in a compliance context. Regulated industry penalties and the per-customer fulfillment requirement drop the total far below validate threshold. Operational autonomy (3) is critically low — this is a professional services engagement, not an autonomous SaaS product.
solution_plan: This would be a Transaction Security policy template generator or consulting playbook for Salesforce admins at Shield + CPQ orgs. Claude could draft policy logic templates and documentation, but applying them correctly to a specific enterprise org requires a Salesforce security architect to validate — otherwise a misconfigured policy could block CPQ operations or expose data. The regulated-industry context (finance, healthcare) adds compliance liability. This cannot be built and delivered hands-off by a solo non-technical operator; it is fundamentally an enterprise consulting engagement that requires Salesforce expertise and security credentials to sell credibly.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy build gate (scored 3, minimum 7). Also fails buildability_with_ai (4, minimum 6). Regulated industry penalty applied. Drop.
